title: ihris-data-list/v1
description: The records one iHRIS package ships for one list form (//I2CE/formsData/forms/<form>/<id>) in a release, each attributed to the module that ships it. `provenance` separates a module's DEFAULT data, installed with the module (e.g. ISO countries, gender), from SAMPLE data (SampleData-* modules and sites), which illustrates one country's lists and must never be read as a standard code set.

id.description: the record id; with the form, the I2CE key `form|id`

fields.description: field -> value as shipped; MAP values are `form|id`
